description: Emplacements de stationnement automobile is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville du Havre. Complete inventory of free and paid parking spaces on the public space of the City of Le Havre (excluding covered parking). Each segment represents a series of parking boxes of similar type (minute stop, coaches, GIG-GIC, deliveries, taxi). Coverage: Ville du Havre. The portal shows the English title as "Car parking spaces" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville du Havre. Its keywords include automobile, donnees, horodateur, estuaire, voiture, seine. The listing shows 5 download or service links in JSON, DXF, KMZ, SHP. The listing shows 2024-04-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
